name: duopore-public-sales-target-gap
description: See how much is left to reach a sales target and what daily pace it would take.
keywords: see your gap to a sales goal

interface.shortDescription: See your gap to a sales goal
interface.longDescription: See how much is left to reach a sales target and what daily pace it would take. Enter your target, sales so far, days left to sell, and an assumed average order value. Get the gap, daily sales pace and whole extra orders needed. These are planning sums based on your figures, not a sales forecast or a promise of results.
capabilities: See your gap to a sales goal
defaultPrompt: How much more do I need to reach my sales target?
Work out the daily sales pace and extra orders needed.

positive.prompt: Use Sales Target Gap with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"targets":[{"targetId":"01","name":"October","targetAmount":1000,"actualAmount":650,"remainingSellingDays":7,"averageOrderValue":80}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts. Expected structured result: {"summary":"1 targets have a remaining sales gap.","rows":[{"targetId":"01","name":"October","targetAmount":1000,"actualAmount":650,"gapAmount":350,"attainmentPercent":65,"requiredPerSellingDay":50,"additionalOrders":5,"status":"gap remaining"}],"warnings":["Scenario arithmetic using supplied selling days and average order value; no demand forecast.","Zero target has undefined attainment; zero remaining days has undefined daily pace."]}
